name: swirl-dissolve
title: Swirl Dissolve
description: A rotating swirl of color bands unwinds to open and winds shut again, and the incoming scene grows out of its center. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .swd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A dramatic chapter break where the frame should visibly transform: reveals, act changes.
The brand can carry hypnotic, rotational motion; band colors take brand palettes well.
avoidWhen: Fast cuts: under about 80 frames the twist arc collapses into noise.
Repeated use within one video: the vortex is a statement move, one per video.
author: Remocn
